name: memestash
description: Search a curated library of images and memes and paste the one you pick into the frontmost app.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1

commands.name: search-memes
commands.title: Search MemeStash
commands.description: Search your MemeStash library and paste the selected image into the frontmost app.

commands.name: add-to-memestash
commands.title: Add to MemeStash
commands.description: Add an image to your MemeStash library with a name and keywords.

preferences.name: libraryPath
preferences.title: Library Folder
preferences.description: Folder that holds your images and the index.json manifest. Leave empty to use ~/Pictures/MemeStash.
